entities.summary: Arthur Rinderknech is a French professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 26 achieved on 12 January 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 104 reached on 16 March 2026. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from France.
